children: (the "Company" or "Arq"), a producer of activated carbon and other environmentally efficient carbon products for use in purification and sustainable materials, today announced the Company will release its third quarter 2026 financial results and file its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the period ended September 30, 2026 after market close on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. A conference call to discuss the Company's financial performance is scheduled for Thursday, November 5, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time.

. Alternatively, the live conference call may be accessed by dialing (888) 396-8049 or +1 (416) 764-8646 and referencing Arq.
